account.intention: Preserve the achieved world: home heart, connected sheltered eastern heart, and amber northern cherished heart coexist.
account.source: After the initial goal at 10, the larger project renewed purpose until the new eastern circuit closed at 35. Old road threat at 39 supplied one further real response at 40.
account.meaningfulResponse: Amber recaptured the intentionally detached K3 outpost at 36. After the F5 seal at 40 it entered an observed four-action cycle: J3 shell south, G5 flame east, H3 shell south, G5 shell west. Each strikes an already closed edge. The same cycle repeated twice with no ownership, history-contact count or reach changes.
account.oldCreationNewRole: The original flame causeway became a protected western memorial rather than the active route. H5 gate and H4/I4/J4/K4 contact cells became the coexistence border. F7/G7/H7 is now the living bridge. First eastern four-cell loop was sacrificed and renewed at I6/I7/J6/J7.
account.uncertaintySkill: Meaningful learning: memory closure needs the intended actual heading, and arriving root reinforcement can teach that history while defending. Terrain transformations and autonomous lingering fronts caused mistakes; exact previews resolved two specific actions.
account.routineBurden: The final eight waits confirmed a repeating blocked policy, not eight interesting decisions. Many earlier typed counters had a clear winning answer. Desire for peaceful structure carried the primitive work, but the game did not renew larger purposes after closure.
account.strongestStretch: Actions 20 through 24: teach the missing northward passage to an old contact cell, then use its actual history to make a boundary without taking cherished cells. Actions 27 through 35: old route lost, lower crossing and sheltered heart created.
account.weakestStretch: Final repeated blocked counterplans, plus local type counter upkeep without a larger architectural change.
account.nextActFor: Finish the world. This is not evidence that the 180 to 240 target sustained meaningful purpose, and is not a claim about human enjoyment.
